lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: I promised to look in on three households this morning, but there’s more here than I can leave unattended.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Who needs us?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: *with concern* Halden first. This is his medicine. His joints have been troubling him again.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: He’ll tell us they’re perfectly well.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: He probably will. He’s milling flour for the Festival of Light, and I suspect he’s trying to carry every sack himself.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Is there much left to do?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Enough to keep the village kitchens waiting if he overworks himself. He should be at his cottage, just south of the mill.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Across the upper bridge?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Yes. Go with Caelan and see whether he needs a hand.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: There’s bread and lamp oil for Elira, too. She’ll be getting her lantern ready for the Festival of Light.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: I’ll call on her.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: She should be at home, by the southern bridge. Please ask how she’s doing while you’re there.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And these supplies are for the Venns, up on the eastern terrace. Their little one’s still recovering.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: *more quietly* Any better?

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: A little, last I heard. They’ve had their hands full between that and the plot.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: I promised to look in on three households this morning, but there’s more here than I can leave unattended.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: *with concern* Halden first. This is his medicine. His joints have been troubling him again.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: He’s milling flour for the Festival of Light, and I suspect he’s trying to carry every sack himself.

tomas.speaker: caelan
tomas.text: Is there much left to do?

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: Enough to keep the village kitchens waiting if he overworks himself. He should be at his cottage, just south of the mill, across the upper bridge.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: There’s bread and lamp oil for Elira, too. She’ll be getting her lantern ready for the Festival of Light.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: She should be at home, by the southern bridge. Please ask how she’s doing while you’re there.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: And these supplies are for the Venns, up on the eastern terrace. Their little one’s still recovering.

tomas.speaker: serene
tomas.text: They’ve had their hands full between that and the plot.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: There you are. How is everyone?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Halden finally accepted the medicine. We moved his flour sacks into the dry.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Did he let you help without an argument?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Not entirely.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: *smiles* I’d have worried if he had.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Elira has the bread and oil. She’s bringing her husband’s lantern tomorrow.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Good. I’m glad she wants to come.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: And the Venns have their supplies. The little one’s keeping food down. Their irrigation gate was caught, so I got the channel running again.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: You’ve had a busy morning.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: A useful one, I think.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: You have. And how were they, aside from what needed fixing?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Halden’s doing more than his joints can bear. Elira misses her husband. The Venns are tired—and worried about what next season will cost them.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: I’m glad you stayed long enough to hear that.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: You knew I’d find more than deliveries.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: I hoped you’d have time for people. It’s easy to think our work is finished when the baskets are empty.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Then I suppose we keep showing up.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: *warmly* That’s a good place to begin.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Try Mira’s workbench outside her workshop, before the upper bridge. Halden needs that mill running for tomorrow’s baking.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Thank you for looking in on everyone, Caelan. Kindness means more when we make time for it.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Halden should be at his cottage, south of the mill. Take the medicine over the upper bridge, and let Tomas help with any carrying.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Elira still needs her bread and lamp oil. Her cottage is by the southern bridge.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: The Venns are up on the eastern terrace, by their plot. Please take those supplies and ask after the little one.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Elira still needs her bread and lamp oil, by the southern bridge. The Venns are up on the eastern terrace, by their plot. You can visit either one next.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And Caelan? Eat something before you go.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: I did.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Half a slice of bread is not a meal.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Sit and eat. There'll be plenty to do before the festival.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: You said that yesterday.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And it was true yesterday.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: One more adjustment. Then I really am getting back to the preparations.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Should I tell Mother Serene that?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Tell her the preparations are progressing. That covers both things.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Caelan, can you look at this?

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: It turns most of the way, then it sticks. I can't see what's catching.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Is the pin bent?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I thought so, but it looks straight.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Have you shown Mira?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Not yet. I wanted to get it working myself.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: You can still ask her.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I know. I will if I can't find it.

lines.speaker: halden
lines.text: Mind the sacks by the door. The mill doesn't give my knees a day off.

lines.speaker: elira
lines.text: Mind that stool. I keep telling myself I'll put it away.

lines.speaker: venn_mother
lines.text: It's been a quiet morning, thankfully.

lines.speaker: venn_father
lines.text: I ought to see to that channel before the afternoon.

lines.speaker: venn_child
lines.text: I had a whole bowl today.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Good. Rest a little longer.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Nearly there. This fitting has other ideas.

lines.speaker: aldric
lines.text: Thank you for bringing us here, Caelan. I'll see you at the festival.

lines.speaker: road_foreman
lines.text: We'll start on the bedding. I still have to find another cart for the stone.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: I hope you can.

lines.speaker: road_foreman
lines.text: So do I. Mind the tools as you pass.

lines.speaker: regent_clerk
lines.text: I'll send the revised hire terms to the foreman.

lines.speaker: regent_driver
lines.text: If you're looking at the brake, keep your fingers clear of the catch. It closes harder than it looks.

note: Serene offers the opening quest through an explicit clicked choice and responds to its saved progress. Tomas retains his approved ambient conversation. Actual household task gameplay is implemented separately; entering a room never completes an errand.
